description: A loading indicator built on the native activity indicator, at any size and color.
overview: `Spinner` wraps the native `ActivityIndicator` in a square `View`. The indicator is scaled from its native small size to the `size` you pass, so it can match text and icon sizes. Its color is set through a class.
usage: Set `size` in points (default `16`) and `colorClassName` with an `accent-*` class, such as `accent-accent` or `accent-danger`. Inside a button, use `accent-on-accent` on the `default` variant so the spinner matches the label.

examples.Colors: Spinners in the label, accent and danger colors.
examples.InButton: Spinners inside disabled buttons next to a label.

Spinner.size: Width and height in points. Defaults to `16`.
Spinner.colorClassName: Class that sets the indicator color. Defaults to `accent-label-secondary`.
Spinner.accessibilityLabel: Label read by screen readers. Defaults to `"Loading"`.

accessibility:
- The wrapper has `role="progressbar"`, is `accessible`, and sets `busy: true` in `accessibilityState`.
- It is announced as `"Loading"` unless you pass another `accessibilityLabel`.
notes:
- The default color uses the `label-secondary` token.
- The look of the indicator comes from the platform's native activity indicator, so it differs between iOS and Android.
